claims.answer: The product-supplied app-control prompt lets the current native agent hand user-requested jobs to another project chat. It is not an automatic hierarchy manager. app_new_chat with a first message starts that chat agent; app_send_message follows up; app_status lists working/recent conversations. Each cross-chat message asks the user for approval. Superagent supplies the app-control instruction and cross-chat MCP tools; the installed coding CLI supplies the model loop. The shipped prompt permits these app actions only when the user asks, and each sent job/message has an approval check.

sources.locator: Overview; What it needs; Pricing; FAQ; routines; boards and private checkouts
sources.finding: Documents the free local Mac app, three native CLI backends, existing subscriptions, parallel worktrees, timer routines and an iOS companion. Quitting stops agents and routine runs.

sources.title: Superagent: app/src/main/agent-backend.ts
sources.locator: module header lines 3-17 and AgentStartOptions; SessionContext
sources.finding: Exact backend documentation identifies Claude stream-json, Codex app-server JSON-RPC and Antigravity agy stream-json integration; the shared account environment can supply native CLI login.

sources.title: Superagent: app/src/main/agent.ts
sources.locator: app/src/main/agent.ts: imports lines 24,43-44; startAgent provider dispatch lines 620-622 calls the native Claude, Codex or Antigravity session backend
sources.finding: The shared session owner selects separate concrete coding-CLI backends and tracks native session identity; provider selection is not just a model-name label.

sources.title: Superagent: app/src/main/routines.ts
sources.locator: module contract lines 15-26; runRoutine; startRoutines lines 437-465
sources.finding: Routines are timed natural-language browser tasks driven by a main-process 60-second ticker. They run one headless turn of the selected engine and only while the Mac app is open.

sources.title: Superagent: app/src/main/app-tools.ts
sources.finding: The product can hand a job to a newly created project chat, starting its own agent; it can inspect working/recent chat status and send another agent a follow-up. Each cross-chat message requires explicit user approval.

sources.title: Superagent: app/src/main/prompts.ts
sources.finding: The product prompt instructs its agent to use app_new_chat/app_send_message/app_status for requested cross-chat work. These tools change user-visible state and are restricted to user-requested actions.

sources.title: Superagent: docs/privacy.html
sources.locator: What we collect; agents; relay; notifications
sources.finding: The companion policy states no iPhone analytics/tracking, local Mac/phone work storage and a blind encrypted relay. Relay infrastructure may retain ordinary connection logs; agent-provider processing remains separate.
